articles.title: CVE-2026-129279
articles.summary: The password reset function in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 returns distinguishable responses for valid and invalid accounts. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can enumerate the email addresses of valid user accounts.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129278
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerII2 remoteControlMSPAStartEndTimeSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can alter the recorded state and times of Take Control remote control tasks and the associated audit log entries.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129277
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the MaintActionGet operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read and cancel the pending maintenance actions of any appliance.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129276
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 AssetDiscoSimplifiedInfoSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can overwrite the asset data recorded for any appliance.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129275
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 allows the repositoryItemGet operation to be called without authentication. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows a policy identifier can download the Automation Manager policy of any customer, including embedded scripts and parameter values.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129274
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 RemoteExecutionTaskSubmit operation or verify task ownership. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit forged results for remote execution tasks belonging to any customer.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129272
articles.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 uses a predictable credential to authenticate appliances to an agent-facing API. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows or guesses an appliance identifier can obtain a valid appliance token and session and impersonate that appliance.
